Array: Returns a Variant array from the given arguments.
Asc: ANSI/Unicode code of the first character.
Atn: Arctangent of a number, in radians.
CallByName: Calls a property or method of an object by name.
Choose: Returns the value at Index from the argument list.
CInt: Converts an expression to Integer, rounding halves away from zero.
Command: Command-line arguments used to start the host.
Cos: Cosine of an angle in radians.
CreateObject: Creates a COM object from a ProgID.
CurDir: Current working directory, optionally for a drive.
CVDate: Converts an expression to Date (Variant subtype).
CVErr: Returns a Variant of subtype Error for a given error number.
DateAdd: Adds an interval to a date.
DateDiff: Number of intervals between two dates.
DatePart: A specified part of a date (year, month, weekday, …).
DateSerial: Date from year, month, and day.
DateValue: Date from a string or expression.
Dir: Next file or folder name matching a path and attributes.
DoEvents: Yields so the host can process pending events.
Environ: Value of an operating-system environment variable.
EOF: True when a file opened for input is at end of file.
Error: Error message text for an error number.
FileDateTime: Date and time a file was last modified.
FileLen: Length of a file in bytes.
Filter: Subset of a string array matching (or excluding) a filter string.
Fix: Integer portion of a number, rounding toward zero.
Format: Formats a value as a string using a format expression.
FormatDateTime: Formats a date/time with a named date format.
FormatNumber: Formats a number with grouping and decimal places.
FormatPercent: Formats a number as a percentage.
FreeFile: Next unused file number for Open.
GetAllSettings: All settings from an application’s registry section.
GetAttr: File-attribute bit flags for a path.
GetObject: Gets a running COM object, or loads one from a file.
GetSetting: A value from an application’s registry section.
IIf: Returns TruePart if the expression is true, otherwise FalsePart.
InputBox: Shows a prompt and returns the text the user entered.
InStr: Position of String2 in String1, or 0 if not found.
InStrRev: Position of a substring, searching from the end.
Int: Integer portion of a number, rounding down.
IPmt: Interest payment for a given period of an annuity.
IsArray: True if the variable is an array.
IsDate: True if the expression can be converted to a date.
IsEmpty: True if a Variant has not been initialized.
IsError: True if the expression is an error value.
IsMissing: True if an Optional Variant argument was omitted.
IsNull: True if the expression is Null.
IsNumeric: True if the expression can be evaluated as a number.
IsObject: True if the identifier refers to an object.
Join: Concatenates a string array with a delimiter.
LBound: Lowest available subscript of an array dimension.
Len: Number of characters in a string, or bytes stored by a variable.
Loc: Current position in an open file.
LOF: Length of an open file in bytes.
Mid: Substring starting at Start, optionally of Length characters.
MonthName: Localized name of a month number.
MsgBox: Shows a message dialog and returns which button was clicked.
NPer: Number of periods for an annuity.
NPV: Net present value of a series of cash flows.
Partition: Range string that a number falls into.
PPmt: Principal payment for a given period of an annuity.
QBColor: RGB color corresponding to a QuickBasic color number.
Rate: Interest rate per period for an annuity.
Replace: Replaces occurrences of Find with Replace in Expression.
RGB: RGB color from red, green, and blue components (0–255).
Round: Number rounded to a given number of decimal places.
Seek: Current file-pointer position, or sets it.
Shell: Runs a program and returns its task ID.
Sin: Sine of an angle in radians.
Space: String of the given number of spaces.
Spc: Inserts spaces in a Print statement.
Split: Splits a string into a string array on a delimiter.
Str: String representation of a number (leading space if positive).
String: String of Length copies of a character.
StrReverse: Characters of a string in reverse order.
Switch: Returns the value paired with the first true expression.
SYD: Sum-of-years’ digits depreciation for a period.
Tab: Tab to a column in a Print statement.
Tan: Tangent of an angle in radians.
TimeSerial: Time from hour, minute, and second.
TimeValue: Time from a string or expression.
Trim: String with leading and trailing spaces removed.
TypeName: VBA type name of a variable or expression.
UBound: Highest available subscript of an array dimension.
Val: Numeric value read from the start of a string.
Weekday: Day of the week as a number.
WeekdayName: Localized name of a weekday number.
